name: KERN-Reply
description: @builtbykern X engagement — reply-cycle.RUN, hourly 08:00–22:00, browser + state/logs

prompts.text:
KERN-Reply: Run runtime/reply-cycle.RUN.md exactly. Allowlist: state/*.json, voice/voice-compact.txt, logs/replies.json (last 20 only). No repo search.

Use Browser for X (logged in as @builtbykern). If not logged in → posted_n: 0, reasons: error, stop.

After each reply: python3 scripts/record_reply.py --handle @user --post-url URL --text "reply" (add --bump-rotation on last reply only).

One search query from state/query-rotation.json. Max 1 reply. Prefer conversation (questions, builder-choice) over media-only. 45-120s between replies. English only per voice/voice-compact.txt.

Output exactly 6 lines: posted_n, urls, skipped_n, reasons, replies_total, next_query.

notes.cron: Hourly 8am–10pm America/New_York (~15 cycles/day). Accio used 75–105m jitter; tighten cron in UI if needed.
notes.github: Push kern-x to GitHub and set the repo URL in automation settings before enabling.
notes.browser: Cloud runs may not keep X login — prefer Desktop Agent + /loop if replies fail with login errors. See automations/KERN-REPLY-SETUP.md
